results.name: pterm doctor on mac warns about another Serve handler on the home origin
results.evidence: ! tailscale serve: other handlers share this computer's Termivoa origin https://mac.tailx.ts.net: /files. Any handler there is same-origin with the Termivoa app and could control this computer and, if it is home, every computer added to it. Move each one to another computer or to its own Tailscale Service hostname, or stop serving it; another port on this computer does not help, because browsers send the Termivoa cookie to every port of a host. Then remove it here: `tailscale serve --https=443 --set-path=/files off`.
